title: Project Management Intern
description:
Project Management Intern

Location: No.23, Ansari St, Ram Nagar, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641009

Mode: On-site | 5 Days Working | Immediate Joiner Only

Stipend: Up to ₹10,000/month with performance based incentives

Policy: BYOD (Bring Your Own Device)

Duration: 6 Months

About the Company

Backdropsource.in is a global e-commerce brand redefining creative display

and visual storytelling. Since 2004, we have been serving photographers,

businesses, and event professionals with high-quality, customizable

backdrops and display solutions.

With a strong international presence across the US, UK, Canada, and Australia, we

continue to innovate and scale globally.

About the Role

The intern will help plan, track and deliver projects across our design, production, sales and customer support teams. You will work closely with the project lead to keep timelines on track, follow up on pending tasks and keep everyone informed.

This role suits someone organized and proactive who wants hands-on exposure to how projects and orders move through a global e-commerce business.

Key Responsibilities

* Track projects and orders from requirement to design, production and dispatch, flagging delays early.
* Maintain project trackers, timelines and task lists in Excel, Google Sheets or project management tools.
* Coordinate with the design, production, sales and customer support teams to keep deliverables on schedule.
* Follow up with team members on pending tasks, approvals and deadlines.
* Prepare daily and weekly status reports for the project lead and management.
* Schedule meetings, record minutes of meetings (MOMs) and track action items to closure.
* Maintain project documentation, checklists and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Identify recurring bottlenecks and suggest improvements to workflows.
* Support other operational and project-related tasks as assigned.

Requirements

* Pursuing or recently completed a bachelor's or master's degree in any discipline (BBA, MBA, B.Com, B.E./B.Tech or similar).
* Working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets, plus MS Word or Google Docs.
* Basic understanding of e-commerce, printing or production workflows.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Jira or Monday.com.
* Basic understanding of e-commerce, printing or production workflows.

What you’ll Gain

* Internship certificate on successful completion of 6 months.
* Hands-on project coordination experience in a global e-commerce brand.
* Mentorship from the project lead and exposure to design, production and sales operations.
* Possibility of a full-time role based on performance and business needs

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹10,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Project Coordinator & QA
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Location:** Ramanathapuram, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Work Mode:** Office

**Salary:** ₹23000 to 30000

JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for a **QA & Project Coordinator** to support software quality assurance and coordinate project activities. The ideal candidate should be detail-oriented, organized, and capable of coordinating effectively with development, QA, and project teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Perform functional, regression, integration, and UI testing
* Prepare and execute test cases and test scenarios
* Identify, document, and track bugs through resolution
* Coordinate with developers and project teams for issue resolution
* Monitor project tasks, timelines, priorities, and deliverables
* Track project progress and provide regular status updates
* Understand project requirements and assist in requirement discussions
* Support UAT, deployment, and release activities
* Maintain QA and project-related documentation
* Ensure projects are delivered with expected quality and within timelines

REQUIREMENTS

* 1–3 years of experience in **QA, Software Testing, or Project Coordination**
* Good understanding of **SDLC, STLC, and Software Testing concepts**
* Experience in manual testing and test case preparation
* Good knowledge of bug tracking and issue management
* Strong communication and coordination skills
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Knowledge of tools such as **Jira, Trello, or similar tools** is an advantage

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

**Software Testing, Manual Testing, QA, Project Coordination, IT Projects, Web Applications, UAT, Bug Tracking, or Software Development.**

WHAT WE OFFER

* Career Growth Opportunities
* Learning & Development
* Exposure to Real-World IT Projects
* Collaborative & Professional Work Environment
* Opportunity to grow in **QA & Project Management**

**Join our team and grow with us!**

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
